item.title: COLLEGE BASKETBALL: Stoute’s buzzer-beater sends Misericordia to MAC Freedom final
item.description: Eli Stoute’s 3-pointer to beat the buzzer lifted Misericordia to a 58-57 victory over Arcadia on Wednesday night at Arcadia in the semifinals of the MAC Freedom conference men’s basketball tournament. The Cougars, the No. 4 seed, will head to Stevens, the No. 2 seed, on Saturday at 5 p.m. to play for the conference championship with an automatic bid to the NCAA Tournament on the line.
